::::

:::::

::::: {.fragment .fade-in}

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column}

$B = 2 = 2^b$ byte-block size<br/>
$b = 1$ (block) offset bits<br/>
$S = 4 = 2^s$ sets<br/>
$s = 2$ (set) index bits

:::

::: {.column}

$m$ = 8 bit addresss<br/>
$t = m - (s + b) = 5$ tag bits

:::

<tr><td>01100</td><td>00</td><td>1</td><td>(61)</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="5">miss</td></tr>
<tr><td>01100</td><td>01</td><td>0</td><td>(62)</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>00000</td><td>00</td><td>0</td><td>(00)</td><td></td></tr>

</thead>

<tr class="fragment custom mybox-one" data-fragment-index="5"><td>00</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="2">1</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="2"><span class="fragment custom myem-only" data-fragment-index="3">00000</span></td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="2">mem[0x00] mem[0x01]</td></tr>
<tr><td>01</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="4">1</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="4">01100</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="4">mem[0x62] mem[0x63]</td></tr>
<tr><td>10</td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>11</td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

::::

:::::


<div class="myoverbox vlow fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="4">
<ul>
<li>access to <tt>0x61</tt> matches set index <tt>00</tt></li>
<li>block's tag <tt>00000</tt> != 0x61's tag of <tt>01100</tt></li>
<li>need to _replace_ value in that block</li>
</ul>
</div>

### example access pattern (steps 4-7) {.smaller}

::::: {.columns}

:::: {.column width=35%}

<table class="cachesim-address">
<colgroup>
    <col class="tag" />
    <col class="index" />
    <col class="offset" />
    <col class="hex" />
    <col class="result" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr><th colspan="4">address (as hex)</th><th>result</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>00000</td><td>00</td><td>0</td><td>(00)</td><td>miss</td></tr>
<tr><td>00000</td><td>00</td><td>1</td><td>(01)</td><td>hit</td></tr>
<tr><td>01100</td><td>01</td><td>1</td><td>(63)</td><td>miss</td></tr>
<tr><td>01100</td><td>00</td><td>1</td><td>(61)</td><td class="fragment myem-until custom" data-fragment-index="1">miss</td></tr>
<tr><td>01100</td><td>01</td><td>0</td><td>(62)</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="2">hit</td></tr>
<tr><td>00000</td><td>00</td><td>0</td><td>(00)</td><td class="fragment myem-only fade-in" data-fragment-index="3">miss</td></tr>
<tr><td>01100</td><td>10</td><td>0</td><td>(64)</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table class="cache-addresslabel">
<tr><td class="tag">tag</td><td class="index">index</td><td class="offset">offset</td></tr>
</table>

::::

:::: {.column width=65%}

<table class="cachesim-cache">
<caption>2 byte blocks, 4 sets</caption>
<thead>
<tr><th>index</th><th>valid</th><th>tag</th><th>value</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="fragment custom mybox-one" data-fragment-index="3"><td>00</td><td class="fragment custom myem-until" data-fragment-index="1">1</td><td class="fragment custom myem-until" data-fragment-index="1">01100</td><td class="fragment custom myem-until" data-fragment-index="1">mem[0x60] mem[0x61]</td></tr>
<tr class="fragment custom myem-only" data-fragment-index="2"><td>01</td><td>1</td><td>01100</td><td>mem[0x62] mem[0x63]</td></tr>
<tr><td>10</td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>11</td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

::::

:::::


<div class="myoverbox vlow fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="3">
<ul>
<li>access to <tt>0x00</tt> is miss even though:
<ul>
<li>we had extra space in the cache to store blocks</li>
<li>we previously accesses the <tt>0x00-0x01</tt> block</li>
</ul></li>
<li>called "conflict miss" (versus "compulsory" or "capacity" miss)</li>
</ul>
</div>

### aside: miss types

*  compulsory:
   *  first access to block
   *  avoid by increasing block size or "prefetching"
*  capacity:
   *  trying to put too much stuff in the cache
   *  avoid with larger cache
*  conflict:
   *  index bits happen to match up too often
   *  avoid with more "associative" cache (next topic)

<div class="myoverbox vlow fragment fade-in-then-out" data-fragment-index="1">
<ul>
<li>place 0x00-0x01 back in cache set 0</li>
<li>would have been better if never replaced...</li>
